what: Deleting the item store's blaze_record lookup for inference, MIR and borrow check means the driver must drive the kernel body entries, or cross-process hits of those steps stop; the driver is another lane's file, so the deletion cannot land in one write-only lane.
cost: the query-side piece moved to the next round
cause: the item store's public surface (install, flush, Flushed) is the driver's, and the kernel entries have no driver yet
class: one concept with two homes until its last caller moves (one-concept-one-home)
prevention: start a piece that moves a concept's home with the driver's lane in the same batch
